Heart Rate Monitor lets you measure your pulse (heart rate) instantly with your iPhone. Our highly advanced algorithm analyzes your blood flow data from your fingertip and gives you an accurate result within seconds. 

Make your everyday life more effective with our data analytics, graphs and charts. It’s an ideal application for tracking your heart rate, analyzing your heart rate in different states and your overall well-being.

KEY FEATURES
• Measure your heart rate only using your iPhone.
• Use a calendar to monitor your heart rate trends.
• Measure your heart rate for different states.
• Monitor HR data for multiple users simultaneously.
• Share your report with a doctor easily. 

INSTRUCTIONS
• Hold your phone steadily, keep calm and don’t talk during the measurement process to increase accuracy.
• Make sure your fingers are not too cold and don’t press too hard on the camera lens to avoid restricting the blood flow in your finger.
• Cover the entire back camera (main lens) lightly with your finger.
